shortBio.en: The Cure’s continuous frontman; chorus/delay guitar and goth-pop voice as brand.
shortBio.zh: The Cure 连续主唱；chorus/延时吉他与哥特流行嗓音即品牌。

whyHub.en: Logo stays readable because Smith stays—cast rotates around one voice/guitar.
whyHub.zh: 卡司围着一把嗓/吉他转，logo 仍可读——因为 Smith 一直在。

body.en:
Writes and sings across cold post-punk, pop singles, and Disintegration-scale albums. Visual brand (hair/makeup) is part of the public object alongside the pedals.

Person page is the constant under lineup churn.
body.zh:
跨冷后朋、流行单曲与 Disintegration 尺度专辑写作演唱。视觉品牌（发型/妆容）与单块同为公共对象。

人物页是阵容更替下的常量。
